def factor_drawdown_average_depth_high(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    rolling_peak = high.rolling(40, min_periods=15).max()
    drawdown = close / rolling_peak - 1.0
    avg_dd = drawdown.rolling(40, min_periods=15).mean()
    factor = avg_dd
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_average_depth_high"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_average_depth_high"]
description: Mutation of parent ulcer index. Parent strength preserved: low turnover, high monotonicity, and positive long_short payoff. Bottleneck targeted: low IC/ICIR/RankIC/MI. We replace squared drawdown stress (ulcer) with average drawdown depth below a 40-day rolling high, removing squared amplification to improve linear cross-sectional predictability. The peak reference shifts from close to high to include intraday stress, while the 40-day lookback keeps duration weighting but reduces lag.
